prompts.prompt: Wide-angle capture of a contemporary dance performance on the wooden stage of Dansens Hus in Stockholm, four dancers mid-leap under cool stage lights, empty orchestra seats in foreground, high-contrast chiaroscuro, shot from balcony like a documentary photo.

Medium shot inside Dansens Hus Stockholm, a dancer in a slate-blue costume rising from a low lunge, single warm spotlight cutting through haze, blurred crimson backdrop, audience silhouettes just visible at frame edge, candid performance photography.

Behind-the-scenes photo in Fallan's arched Stockholm brick cellar, a dancer stretching at a wooden barre while three others adjust pointe shoes on worn floorboards, daylight from a small window mixing with cool exit light, lived-in rehearsal atmosphere.

Close detail shot on Dansens Hus stage, a dancer's arched bare foot pressing into scuffed marley flooring, fabric of costume hem curling mid-turn, single raked amber stage light raking across skin texture, shallow depth of field.

Intimate candid photo in MDT Moderna Dansteatern's black-box studio Stockholm, two dancers touching foreheads in stillness, soft overhead work-light glow on sweat-sheened shoulders, dust motes drifting through the warm beam, gentle documentary framing.
